steps.title: Make fences
steps.say: Craft [fences](item:oak_fence) from 4 [planks](item:oak_planks) and 2 [sticks](item:stick). Each craft makes 3 fences.

steps.title: Make a gate
steps.say: Craft a [fence gate](item:oak_fence_gate) from 4 [sticks](item:stick) and 2 [planks](item:oak_planks).

steps.title: Build the square
steps.say: Pick a flat grassy spot. Put [fences](item:oak_fence) in a square, and use the gate as one of the sides.

steps.title: Light it up
steps.say: Put [torches](item:torch) on the [fence](item:oak_fence) posts so monsters can not spawn inside.

steps.title: Bring animals in
steps.say: Hold their food and they follow you. Walk them through the gate, then close it behind you.

steps.title: Or use a lead
steps.say: Use a [lead](item:lead) on an animal to walk it like a dog. Tie the lead to a [fence](item:oak_fence) post to keep it there.

title: Find a fortress and get blaze rods

steps.title: Find the fortress
steps.say: Nether fortresses are big castles of dark [Nether bricks](item:nether_bricks) with long bridges, often over lava. Explore the Nether until you see one.

steps.title: Find the blazes
steps.say: Look for a blaze spawner, a cage with fire inside, often on a raised platform.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.say: Blazes fly and shoot fireballs. A [shield](item:shield) and a [potion](item:potion) of fire resistance help a lot.

steps.title: Fight them
steps.say: Hit them with a [sword](item:wooden_sword), or shoot [arrows](item:arrow). [Snowballs](item:snowball) hurt blazes too.

steps.title: Collect the rods
steps.say: Blazes sometimes drop a [blaze rod](item:blaze_rod). Keep fighting until you have about 6 or more.

steps.title: Make powder
steps.say: Craft each [blaze rod](item:blaze_rod) into 2 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder), for [brewing stands](item:brewing_stand) and [eyes of ender](item:ender_eye).

steps.title: Watch out
steps.say: [Wither skeletons](mob:wither_skeleton) live in fortresses too. Their hits turn your hearts black and drain your health.

steps.title: Find 2 animals
steps.say: You need 2 grown-up animals of the same kind, close together.

steps.title: Use their favorite food
steps.say: [Cows](mob:cow) and [sheep](mob:sheep) like wheat, [pigs](mob:pig) like [carrots](item:carrot), and [chickens](mob:chicken) like seeds.

steps.title: Feed both
steps.say: Feed one animal, then the other. Hearts float up, and they walk to each other.

steps.title: Meet the baby
steps.say: A baby animal appears, and you get a little experience.

steps.title: Wait to do it again
steps.say: Each parent has to wait 5 minutes before it can breed again.

steps.title: Watch it grow
steps.say: Babies grow up in about 20 minutes. Feeding a baby makes it grow faster.

steps.title: Keep them close
steps.say: Animals follow you while you hold their food. [Lead](item:lead) them into a fenced pen so they stay.

steps.title: Make a brewing stand
steps.say: Craft 1 [blaze rod](item:blaze_rod) on top of 3 [cobblestone](item:cobblestone).

steps.title: Add fuel
steps.say: Put [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) in the fuel slot. 1 powder brews 20 times.

steps.title: Fill bottles
steps.say: Make [glass bottles](item:glass_bottle) from [glass](item:glass), fill them at water, and put up to 3 in the bottom slots.

steps.title: Add nether wart
steps.say: Put [nether wart](item:nether_wart) in the top slot to make awkward [potions](item:potion). Nether wart grows in Nether fortresses.

steps.title: Pick a power
steps.say: Add one more thing on top: [sugar](item:sugar) for speed, a [golden carrot](item:golden_carrot) for night vision, or a [glistering melon slice](item:glistering_melon_slice) for healing.

steps.title: More potions
steps.say: [Magma cream](item:magma_cream) makes fire resistance, a [pufferfish](mob:pufferfish) makes water breathing, and [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) makes strength.

steps.title: Make them better
steps.say: [Glowstone dust](item:glowstone_dust) makes a [potion](item:potion) stronger, and redstone makes it last longer. [Gunpowder](item:gunpowder) turns it into a [splash potion](item:splash_potion) you throw.

steps.title: Get a nether star
steps.say: Defeating the [Wither](mob:wither) drops a [nether star](item:nether_star). The Wither is a very strong boss, so get help from a grown-up or a friend.

steps.title: Craft the beacon
steps.say: Put the [nether star](item:nether_star) in the middle, 5 [glass](item:glass) around the top, and 3 [obsidian](item:obsidian) along the bottom.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.say: Make a 3 by 3 square of 9 [blocks of iron](item:iron_block), gold, [emerald](item:emerald) or [diamond](item:diamond). You can mix them.

steps.title: Put the beacon on top
steps.say: Place the beacon in the middle of the square. Nothing can block the sky above it, except [glass](item:glass).

steps.title: Pick a power
steps.say: Open the beacon, pick a power like speed or haste, and pay with an [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot), [gold ingot](item:gold_ingot), [emerald](item:emerald) or [diamond](item:diamond).

steps.title: Make it stronger
steps.say: Add bigger layers under it: 5 by 5, then 7 by 7, then 9 by 9. Each one unlocks more powers.

title: Catch an axolotl in a bucket

steps.title: Find a lush cave
steps.say: Axolotls swim in the water in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves). Look for green moss, glowing berries and an [azalea](item:azalea) tree above.

steps.title: Fill a bucket
steps.say: Make a [bucket](item:bucket) from 3 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot), then fill it with water.

steps.title: Scoop it up
steps.say: Use the [water bucket](item:water_bucket) on the axolotl. Now it is in your [bucket](item:bucket).

steps.title: Bring it home
steps.say: Use the [bucket](item:bucket) where you want it to live, like a pond. It needs water, or it dries out.

steps.title: Feed it
steps.say: Axolotls eat [buckets of tropical fish](item:tropical_fish_bucket). Catch [tropical fish](mob:tropical_fish) the same way, with a [water bucket](item:water_bucket).

steps.title: Team up
steps.say: Axolotls fight [drowned](mob:drowned) and [guardians](mob:guardian) with you. A hurt axolotl plays dead to heal.

title: Make a chicken and egg farm

steps.title: Find chickens
steps.say: Chickens live on grassy land. Hold seeds and they follow you.

steps.title: Make a pen
steps.say: Build a small fenced pen with a gate, and bring the chickens inside.

steps.title: Collect eggs
steps.say: Every grown-up chicken lays an egg every 5 to 10 minutes. Walk over the eggs to pick them up.

steps.title: Throw eggs
steps.say: Throw an egg, and 1 time in 8 a chick hatches. Sometimes you even get 4!

steps.title: Breed them
steps.say: Feed 2 chickens seeds and a chick is born. It grows up in about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Get the rest
steps.say: Chickens drop [feathers](item:feather) and [raw chicken](item:chicken). Cook the chicken first, because raw chicken can make you sick.

steps.title: Find a zombie villager
steps.say: It looks like a [zombie](mob:zombie) with a villager nose and clothes. They come out at night.

steps.title: Trap it in the shade
steps.say: [Lead](item:lead) it into a hole or a room with a roof, so it can not reach you and sunlight can not burn it.

steps.title: Make a weakness potion
steps.say: Brew a water bottle with a [fermented spider eye](item:fermented_spider_eye). Add [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to make it a [splash potion](item:splash_potion).

steps.title: Throw it
steps.say: Throw the [splash potion](item:splash_potion) of weakness at the zombie villager.

steps.title: Feed it a golden apple
steps.say: Right away, use a [golden apple](item:golden_apple) on it. Use a plain one, not an enchanted one.

steps.title: Wait
steps.say: It starts to shake. After 3 to 5 minutes it turns back into a villager.

steps.title: Get a thank-you
steps.say: A villager you cured gives you lower prices when you trade.

title: Deal with creepers
askedAs: creepers keep blowing up my house

steps.title: Listen for the hiss
steps.say: A creeper hisses when it gets close. It explodes 1.5 seconds later.

steps.title: Back away
steps.say: When you hear the hiss, run away right away. If you get far enough, it stops and does not explode.

steps.title: Hit and step back
steps.say: Hit it with a [sword](item:wooden_sword), then step back. Hitting knocks it away, so it can not explode next to you.

steps.title: Use a bow
steps.say: Shoot creepers from far away with a [bow](item:bow) and [arrows](item:arrow). That is the safest way.

steps.title: Block with a shield
steps.say: Hold up a [shield](item:shield) to block most of the blast.

steps.title: Get a cat
steps.say: Creepers run away from [cats](mob:cat) and [ocelots](mob:ocelot). A cat at home keeps them away.

steps.title: Light up your home
steps.say: Creepers spawn in the dark. [Torches](item:torch) around your house stop them spawning there.

steps.title: Collect gunpowder
steps.say: Creepers drop [gunpowder](item:gunpowder). Use it for [TNT](item:tnt), [firework rockets](item:firework_rocket) and [splash potions](item:splash_potion).

steps.title: Craft the table
steps.say: Craft an enchanting table from 1 [book](item:book), 2 [diamonds](item:diamond) and 4 [obsidian](item:obsidian), set out like the picture. You need a [diamond pickaxe](item:diamond_pickaxe) or better to mine obsidian.

steps.title: Make 15 bookshelves
steps.say: For the best enchantments you need 15 bookshelves. Each one takes 6 [wood planks](item:oak_planks) and 3 [books](item:book), and a book is 3 [paper](item:paper) and 1 [leather](item:leather).

steps.title: Place the bookshelves
steps.say: Place the table with 15 bookshelves around it like the picture, with 1 empty block between them. Even a [torch](item:torch) in that gap stops a [bookshelf](item:bookshelf) from working.

steps.title: Mine lapis lazuli
steps.say: Mine [lapis lazuli ore](item:lapis_ore) with a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe) or better. Each one drops 4 to 9 lapis, and it's most common near Y 0.

steps.title: Earn experience levels
steps.say: Earn levels by defeating monsters, mining ores like [coal](item:coal) or [diamond](item:diamond), and smelting. The best enchantments need level 30.

steps.title: Put in your item
steps.say: Use the enchanting table and put in something that isn't enchanted yet, like a [sword](item:wooden_sword), [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe), armor or a [book](item:book). Then add 3 [lapis lazuli](item:lapis_lazuli).

steps.title: Pick the bottom choice
steps.say: With all 15 bookshelves, the bottom choice needs level 30 but only uses up 3 levels and 3 lapis. It usually gives the best enchantments.

title: Find an End city and get elytra

steps.title: Beat the dragon
steps.say: First defeat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon). A small gateway portal opens near the edge of the main island.

steps.title: Go through the gateway
steps.say: The gateway is a tiny portal floating in bedrock. Throw an [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl) into it to go through.

steps.title: Look for purple towers
steps.say: On the outer islands, look for tall purple towers. That is an [End city](place:end_city). Bring blocks to bridge between islands.

steps.title: Watch out for shulkers
steps.say: [Shulkers](mob:shulker) hide in boxes and shoot bullets that make you float up. Stay close to the ground, so the fall back down is short.

steps.title: Find the ship
steps.say: Some [End cities](place:end_city) have a ship floating nearby. The elytra hang in an [item frame](item:item_frame) at the back of the ship.

steps.title: Wear your wings
steps.say: Put the elytra on in your [chest](item:chest) armor slot.

steps.title: Fly!
steps.say: Jump off something high, then jump again in the air to glide. Use [firework rockets](item:firework_rocket) to fly faster and higher.

steps.title: Get your gear ready
steps.say: This is a big, tough fight. Bring armor, a [sword](item:wooden_sword), a [bow](item:bow), lots of [arrows](item:arrow), food and blocks. Never sleep in a [bed](item:white_bed) in the End, because it explodes.

steps.title: Make eyes of ender
steps.say: Craft each [eye of ender](item:ender_eye) from 1 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) and 1 [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl). Make at least 12, plus a few spares, because some eyes break when you throw them.

steps.title: Find the stronghold
steps.say: Throw an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye) and follow it. Pick it up if it drops. When it flies down instead of up, dig down to find the [stronghold](place:stronghold).

steps.title: Open the End portal
steps.say: Place an eye in every empty portal frame. When all 12 have eyes, the portal opens. Jump in, then stay away from the edges and don't look at [endermen](mob:enderman).

steps.title: Break the crystals
steps.say: Shoot the crystals on the towers first, because they heal the dragon. For the 2 in cages, build up, break some [bars](item:iron_bars), then shoot from a few blocks away.

steps.title: Fight the dragon
steps.say: Shoot the dragon with [arrows](item:arrow) while it flies. When it lands on the portal in the middle, hit it with your [sword](item:wooden_sword). Stay out of its breath and purple clouds.

steps.title: Collect the egg
steps.say: Hit the egg once and it jumps to the ground nearby. Put a [torch](item:torch) 2 blocks under it, then break the block it sits on, so it drops for you.

steps.title: Go home
steps.say: When the dragon is beaten, the portal in the middle turns on. Jump in to go home. You'll come back at your [bed](item:white_bed), or where you first started.

steps.title: Pack for the trip
steps.say: Bring an [iron pickaxe](item:iron_pickaxe) or better, a spare [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe), food, [torches](item:torch) and a [water bucket](item:water_bucket). A weaker pickaxe breaks [diamond ore](item:diamond_ore) but gives you nothing.

steps.title: Turn on coordinates
steps.say: In your world settings, turn on Show Coordinates. The middle number is Y, and it tells you how high or deep you are.

steps.title: Dig down safely
steps.say: Dig down like a staircase, never straight under your feet. Digging straight down can drop you into a cave or into lava.

steps.title: Stop at minus 53
steps.say: Stop when Y says minus 53. Diamonds are common there, and the lava that fills the deepest caves stays below your feet.

steps.title: Watch for lava
steps.say: Lava can still show up down here. Pour water from your [bucket](item:bucket) onto it to turn it into [obsidian](item:obsidian) or [cobblestone](item:cobblestone).

steps.title: Dig long tunnels
steps.say: Dig a long, flat tunnel 2 blocks high and 1 block wide. Place [torches](item:torch) as you go so you can see and fewer monsters spawn.

steps.title: Avoid the sculk
steps.say: If your tunnel opens into a cave covered in [sculk](item:sculk), turn back and dig somewhere else. Sculk shriekers there can call the [Warden](mob:warden), a very strong monster.

steps.title: Mine the diamonds
steps.say: When you find [diamond ore](item:diamond_ore), mine the blocks around it first so no diamond can fall into lava. Each ore gives 1 diamond.

steps.title: Look underground
steps.say: Geodes are big round rocks underground, from the bottom of the world up to level 30.

steps.title: Spot the outside
steps.say: The outside is a layer of dark gray [smooth basalt](item:smooth_basalt), then white [calcite](item:calcite). You often see it in cave walls.

steps.title: Break in
steps.say: Dig through the layers. Inside is purple amethyst, with crystals growing on the walls.

steps.title: Collect the shards
steps.say: Break the big, fully grown crystals with a [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) to get [amethyst shards](item:amethyst_shard). Small ones give nothing.

steps.title: Leave the budding blocks
steps.say: [Budding amethyst](item:budding_amethyst) grows new crystals but breaks if you mine it. Leave it, and come back later for more.

steps.title: Use your shards
steps.say: Make a [spyglass](item:spyglass) from 1 [amethyst shard](item:amethyst_shard) and 2 [copper ingots](item:copper_ingot), or [tinted glass](item:tinted_glass) from shards and [glass](item:glass).

steps.title: Bring a stone pickaxe
steps.say: You need a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe) or better. A [wooden pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) breaks [iron ore](item:iron_ore) but gives you nothing.

steps.title: Know what it looks like
steps.say: [Iron ore](item:iron_ore) is [stone](item:stone) with light brown and orange spots. Deep down it is in dark [deepslate](item:deepslate) instead.

steps.title: Look in caves
steps.say: Explore caves with [torches](item:torch) and check the walls. Iron is very common around level 16.

steps.title: Or climb a mountain
steps.say: There is lots of iron high up in mountains too. Look for spots on cliff sides.

steps.title: Mine it
steps.say: Each [iron ore](item:iron_ore) gives you raw iron. A [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) with Fortune can give you more.

steps.title: Smelt it
steps.say: Put raw iron in a [furnace](item:furnace) with fuel like [coal](item:coal). Each one turns into an [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot).

steps.title: Know where they are
steps.say: Woodland mansions are in [dark forests](biome:dark_forest) and [pale gardens](biome:pale_garden). They are rare, and often thousands of blocks away.

steps.title: Get a map
steps.say: A master cartographer villager sells a map to a woodland mansion for [emeralds](item:emerald) and a [compass](item:compass).

steps.title: Follow the map
steps.say: Hold the map and walk until your marker reaches the mansion mark. It is a long trip, so bring food.

steps.title: Get ready to fight
steps.say: [Vindicators](mob:vindicator) swing [axes](item:wooden_axe), and [evokers](mob:evoker) send flying [vexes](mob:vex). Wear armor and bring a [shield](item:shield).

steps.title: Look around inside
steps.say: Mansions have many rooms, with [chests](item:chest) and sometimes [allays](mob:allay) in cages.

steps.title: Win a totem
steps.say: [Evokers](mob:evoker) drop a [totem of undying](item:totem_of_undying). Hold it, and it saves you once from dying.

steps.title: Go to a swamp at night
steps.say: Slimes come out in [swamps](biome:swamp) and [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp) at night. A full moon brings the most.

steps.title: Or dig down
steps.say: Underground, below level 40, slimes appear in some areas called slime chunks, even in the light.

steps.title: Find a slime chunk
steps.say: Dig a big room below level 40. If slimes keep showing up there, you found one.

steps.title: Fight them
steps.say: Big slimes split into smaller ones. The tiniest ones drop [slimeballs](item:slime_ball).

steps.title: Let frogs help
steps.say: [Frogs](mob:frog) eat tiny slimes and leave a [slimeball](item:slime_ball) behind.

steps.title: Use the slimeballs
steps.say: Make a [lead](item:lead), a [sticky piston](item:sticky_piston), or a [slime block](item:slime_block) that you can bounce on.

steps.title: Get ender pearls
steps.say: Defeat [endermen](mob:enderman) to get [ender pearls](item:ender_pearl). You need about 12 or more.

steps.title: Get blaze powder
steps.say: Get [blaze rods](item:blaze_rod) from [blazes](mob:blaze) in a [Nether fortress](place:nether_fortress). Each rod makes 2 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder).

steps.title: Make eyes of ender
steps.say: Put 1 [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl) and 1 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) together in the crafting grid to make an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye).

steps.title: Throw one
steps.say: Throw an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye) in the Overworld. It flies toward the nearest stronghold, so walk that way.

steps.title: Pick it back up
steps.say: Most eyes drop down so you can take them again, but 1 in 5 breaks. Bring extra.

steps.title: Dig down
steps.say: When the eye flies down into the ground, the stronghold is under you. Dig down carefully, never straight below your feet.

steps.title: Find the portal room
steps.say: Look for a room with a lava pool and steps up to a ring of 12 frame blocks.

steps.title: Fill the frame
steps.say: Put an eye in every frame that needs one. The portal to the End opens, and the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon) is waiting.

steps.title: Pick the right land
steps.say: Villages are in [plains](biome:plains), [deserts](biome:desert), [savannas](biome:savanna), [taigas](biome:taiga), [meadows](biome:meadow) and [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains). Start your search there.

steps.title: Look from up high
steps.say: Climb a hill or a tall tree and look around. Villages have roofs, paths and fields you can see from far away.

steps.title: Follow a path
steps.say: [Dirt](item:dirt) paths [lead](item:lead) into villages. If you find one, follow it.

steps.title: Find the middle
steps.say: The [bell](item:bell) sits in the middle of the village, where villagers meet during the day.

steps.title: Be kind
steps.say: Do not hit villagers. The [iron golem](mob:iron_golem) protects them and fights back.

steps.title: Remember the way
steps.say: Write down the coordinates, or build a tall tower of blocks with a [torch](item:torch) on top. Then you can find it again.

steps.title: Chop some trees
steps.say: Hold the attack [button](item:oak_button) on a tree trunk to break it. Collect about 10 [logs](item:oak_log) before the sun goes down.

steps.title: Make planks and a table
steps.say: Turn your [logs](item:oak_log) into [planks](item:oak_planks) in your inventory. Then make a [crafting table](item:crafting_table) from 4 planks and put it down.

steps.title: Make a pickaxe
steps.say: Make [sticks](item:stick) from 2 [planks](item:oak_planks). A [wooden pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) takes 3 planks and 2 sticks at the [crafting table](item:crafting_table).

steps.title: Get some stone
steps.say: Mine [stone](item:stone) with your [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) to get [cobblestone](item:cobblestone). Make a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe) and a [stone sword](item:stone_sword). They are stronger than wood.

steps.title: Make torches
steps.say: Look for [stone](item:stone) with black spots: that is [coal ore](item:coal_ore). 1 [coal](item:coal) and 1 [stick](item:stick) make 4 [torches](item:torch).

steps.title: Build a shelter
steps.say: Before dark, dig into a hill or build a small hut. Block the doorway and put [torches](item:torch) inside.

steps.title: Stay inside at night
steps.say: [Zombies](mob:zombie), [skeletons](mob:skeleton), [spiders](mob:spider) and [creepers](mob:creeper) come out in the dark. Stay inside, mine, and craft until the sun comes up.

steps.title: Make a bed
steps.say: Get 3 [wool](item:white_wool) of the same color from [sheep](mob:sheep) and add 3 [planks](item:oak_planks) to make a [bed](item:white_bed). Sleeping skips the night.

steps.title: Watch your hunger bar
steps.say: The drumsticks show your hunger. When they get low you can not sprint, and when they are gone you start losing health.

steps.title: Find animals
steps.say: [Cows](mob:cow), [pigs](mob:pig), [sheep](mob:sheep) and [chickens](mob:chicken) drop raw meat. Look for them on grassy land.

steps.title: Cook the meat
steps.say: Cook raw meat in a [furnace](item:furnace) with [coal](item:coal) or wood as fuel. Cooked meat fills you up much more.

steps.title: Pick apples
steps.say: Break the [leaves](item:oak_leaves) on oak and dark oak trees. Sometimes an [apple](item:apple) drops out.

steps.title: Bake bread
steps.say: Put 3 wheat in a row at a [crafting table](item:crafting_table) to make [bread](item:bread). [Village](place:village) farms have wheat, [carrots](item:carrot) and [potatoes](item:potato).

steps.title: Grab berries
steps.say: [Sweet berry bushes](item:sweet_berry_bush) grow in [taigas](biome:taiga). Pick the red berries and eat them right away.

steps.title: Go fishing
steps.say: Fish with a [fishing rod](item:fishing_rod) when there are no animals around. Cook [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon) before you eat it.

steps.title: Eat the best food
steps.say: [Steak](item:cooked_beef) and cooked porkchops fill 4 drumsticks. [Golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) keep you full the longest.

title: Get a fox to trust you

steps.title: Find foxes
steps.say: Red foxes live in [taigas](biome:taiga). White foxes live in [snowy taigas](biome:snowy_taiga) and [groves](biome:grove).

steps.title: Get berries
steps.say: Pick [sweet berries](item:sweet_berries) from bushes in [taigas](biome:taiga), or [glow berries](item:glow_berries) in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves).

steps.title: Sneak up
steps.say: Foxes run from you. Sneak slowly so they stay put. They are easiest to reach while they sleep in the daytime.

steps.title: Feed 2 foxes
steps.say: Feed berries to 2 grown-up foxes. Hearts show and a baby fox is born.

steps.title: The baby trusts you
steps.say: Grown-up foxes never trust you, but the baby does. It will not run from you.

steps.title: Take it home
steps.say: Put a [lead](item:lead) on the baby fox and walk it home. A fox that trusts you attacks mobs that hurt you.

steps.title: Make a fishing rod
steps.say: Craft a fishing rod from 3 [sticks](item:stick) and 2 [string](item:string). [Spiders](mob:spider) drop string.

steps.title: Find water
steps.say: Any water works, like a lake, a [river](biome:river) or the [ocean](biome:ocean).

steps.title: Cast the line
steps.say: Use the rod while looking at the water. The bobber lands and floats.

steps.title: Watch for bubbles
steps.say: Wait for a little line of bubbles to swim to the bobber. When the bobber dips under, use the rod to reel in.

steps.title: See what you got
steps.say: You get fish most of the time, sometimes junk, and sometimes treasure like a [name tag](item:name_tag) or an [enchanted book](item:enchanted_book).

steps.title: Do not eat pufferfish
steps.say: [Pufferfish](mob:pufferfish) make you sick and poison you. Cook your [raw cod](item:cod) and [raw salmon](item:salmon) instead.

steps.title: Fish faster
steps.say: Fish bite faster in the rain. Lure and Luck of the Sea enchantments help too.

steps.title: Find a bee nest
steps.say: [Bee nests](item:bee_nest) hang from trees in [meadows](biome:meadow), [plains](biome:plains) and [flower forests](biome:flower_forest). Bees fly in and out of them.

steps.title: Light a campfire under it
steps.say: Put a [campfire](item:campfire) on the ground a few blocks below the nest. The smoke keeps the bees calm.

steps.title: Wait for honey
steps.say: When the nest is full, honey drips out of it and you can see honey on its sides.

steps.title: Get honey
steps.say: Use a [glass bottle](item:glass_bottle) on the full nest to get a [honey bottle](item:honey_bottle).

steps.title: Get honeycomb
steps.say: Or use [shears](item:shears) on the full nest to get 3 [honeycomb](item:honeycomb).

steps.title: Make your own hive
steps.say: Craft a [beehive](item:beehive) from 6 [planks](item:oak_planks) and 3 [honeycomb](item:honeycomb). Hold a flower and bees follow you to it.

steps.title: Plant flowers
steps.say: Plant flowers near the hive so the bees stay busy. They help your crops grow too.

steps.title: Get redstone
steps.say: Mine [redstone ore](item:redstone_ore) with an [iron pickaxe](item:iron_pickaxe) or better. It gives you [redstone dust](item:redstone).

steps.title: Make a lamp
steps.say: Put 1 [glowstone](item:glowstone) in the middle with 4 [redstone dust](item:redstone) around its sides.

steps.title: Make a lever
steps.say: Put 1 [stick](item:stick) on top of 1 [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) in the crafting grid.

steps.title: Put them together
steps.say: Place the lamp, then put the [lever](item:lever) right on its side. Flip the lever and the lamp lights up.

steps.title: Go farther
steps.say: To put the [lever](item:lever) farther away, draw a line of [redstone dust](item:redstone) on the ground from the lever to the lamp.

steps.title: Even farther
steps.say: [Redstone dust](item:redstone) only carries power 15 blocks. A [redstone repeater](item:repeater) in the line makes it go farther.

title: Light up an area so mobs don't spawn

steps.title: Monsters need dark
steps.say: [Zombies](mob:zombie), [skeletons](mob:skeleton), [creepers](mob:creeper) and [spiders](mob:spider) only spawn where it is really dark. Any light from a torch stops them.

steps.title: Make lots of torches
steps.say: Each [coal](item:coal) and [stick](item:stick) makes 4 torches. [Charcoal](item:charcoal) from burning [logs](item:oak_log) works too.

steps.title: Spread them out
steps.say: Put a torch about every 10 blocks, all over the area. Do not leave dark patches between them.

steps.title: Light caves as you go
steps.say: In caves, put torches on your right as you walk in. On the way out, keep them on your left.

steps.title: Brighter lights
steps.say: [Lanterns](item:lantern), [glowstone](item:glowstone) and [sea lanterns](item:sea_lantern) give even more light, and look nice in a house.

steps.title: A safe place
steps.say: In [mushroom fields](biome:mushroom_fields), monsters do not spawn on the land, even in the dark.

title: Make a bed and set your spawn

steps.title: Get 3 wool
steps.say: Use [shears](item:shears) on a [sheep](mob:sheep), or defeat one, to get [wool](item:white_wool). You need 3 wool of the same color.

steps.title: Craft the bed
steps.say: At a [crafting table](item:crafting_table), put 3 [wool](item:white_wool) across the middle row and 3 [planks](item:oak_planks) under them. Any kind of planks works.

steps.title: Put it somewhere safe
steps.say: Place the bed inside your house, where monsters can not reach it. It takes up 2 blocks.

steps.title: Set your spawn
steps.say: Use the bed, even in the daytime. You see "Respawn point set", and you come back here if you die.

steps.title: Sleep at night
steps.say: Use the bed at night or in a thunderstorm to sleep and skip to morning. Everyone in the world has to sleep.

steps.title: If you can not sleep
steps.say: If it says monsters are nearby, find them and fight them, or block them out. Then try again.

steps.title: Keep your bed safe
steps.say: If your bed breaks or gets blocked in, you come back at the world spawn instead. Never sleep in the Nether or the End: beds explode there.

steps.title: Craft it
steps.say: Put 5 [planks](item:oak_planks) of the same wood in a U shape: 2 on top at the sides and 3 across the bottom.

steps.title: Put it on water
steps.say: Look at the water and use the boat to place it.

steps.title: Get in
steps.say: Use the boat to climb in. Use the move [buttons](item:oak_button) to paddle and turn.

steps.title: Bring a friend
steps.say: A boat has 2 seats. A friend or an animal can ride with you.

steps.title: Carry more
steps.say: Craft a boat with a [chest](item:chest) to carry your things. It only has 1 seat.

steps.title: Pick it up
steps.say: Hit the boat a few times to break it and get it back.

steps.title: Make paper
steps.say: Craft 3 [sugar cane](item:sugar_cane) in a row to get 3 [paper](item:paper).

steps.title: Craft a map
steps.say: Fill the whole crafting grid with 9 [paper](item:paper) to make an empty map.

steps.title: Add a compass
steps.say: For a map that shows where you are, put a [compass](item:compass) in the middle with 8 [paper](item:paper) around it.

steps.title: Fill it in
steps.say: Hold the map and use it. It draws the land around you, and more appears as you walk.

steps.title: Zoom out
steps.say: At a [cartography table](item:cartography_table), add [paper](item:paper) to your map to show more land. You can do it 4 times.

steps.title: Make a copy
steps.say: At a [cartography table](item:cartography_table), add an empty map to copy yours, so a friend can have one.

steps.title: Hang them up
steps.say: Put maps in [item frames](item:item_frame) on a wall, side by side, to make one big map.

steps.title: Make rails
steps.say: Craft 6 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) and 1 [stick](item:stick) into 16 rails.

steps.title: Make a minecart
steps.say: Craft 5 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) in a U shape into a [minecart](item:minecart).

steps.title: Lay the track
steps.say: Put rails down in a line on solid ground. They curve on their own when you turn a corner.

steps.title: Add powered rails
steps.say: [Powered rails](item:powered_rail) push you along. Craft them from 6 [gold ingots](item:gold_ingot), 1 [stick](item:stick) and 1 [redstone dust](item:redstone).

steps.title: Turn them on
steps.say: A [powered rail](item:powered_rail) needs power. Put a [redstone torch](item:redstone_torch) right next to it. Add more powered rails along the way, most of all going uphill.

steps.title: Ride it
steps.say: Put the [minecart](item:minecart) on the rails and get in. Start on a [powered rail](item:powered_rail) to get going.

steps.title: Stop at the end
steps.say: A [powered rail](item:powered_rail) with no power works like a brake. Put one at the end of your track.

title: Build a Nether portal
askedAs: how to get to the nether

steps.title: Get 10 obsidian
steps.say: You need 10 [obsidian](item:obsidian). Mine it with a [diamond](item:diamond) or [netherite pickaxe](item:netherite_pickaxe), because a weaker [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) gets you nothing.

steps.title: Make flint and steel
steps.say: Craft [flint and steel](item:flint_and_steel) from 1 [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot) and 1 [flint](item:flint). Mining [gravel](item:gravel) sometimes drops flint.

steps.title: Build the frame
steps.say: Stand 10 [obsidian](item:obsidian) up like a big [door](item:oak_door), as in the picture. The hole inside is 2 blocks wide and 3 tall, and corners can be any block or empty.

steps.title: Light it
steps.say: Use your [flint and steel](item:flint_and_steel) on the inside of the frame. A purple swirl fills the [door](item:oak_door) when it works.

steps.title: Pack for the Nether
steps.say: Keep your [flint and steel](item:flint_and_steel) with you. In the Nether, water from a [bucket](item:bucket) vanishes, and a [bed](item:white_bed) explodes if you try to sleep in it.

steps.title: Step inside
steps.say: Stand inside the portal and wait about 4 seconds. You'll come out of a portal in the Nether, and that portal is your way home.

steps.title: Remember your portal
steps.say: Before you explore, check your coordinates next to the portal and write them down. That way you can find it again.

steps.title: Light it again
steps.say: If a [ghast](mob:ghast)'s fireball blows out your portal, use your [flint and steel](item:flint_and_steel) on the frame to light it again. Then step in to go home.

title: Stay safe in the Nether
askedAs: what to bring to the nether

steps.title: Pack well
steps.say: Bring armor, a [sword](item:wooden_sword), a [bow](item:bow), food, lots of blocks, and your [flint and steel](item:flint_and_steel) to relight the portal.

steps.title: Wear some gold
steps.say: [Piglins](mob:piglin) attack unless you wear at least 1 piece of gold armor. A [golden helmet](item:golden_helmet) is enough.

steps.title: Watch for lava
steps.say: Lava is everywhere. Walk carefully, and never dig straight down below your feet.

steps.title: Do not sleep
steps.say: [Beds](item:white_bed) explode in the Nether. Water from a [bucket](item:bucket) disappears too.

steps.title: Fight ghasts
steps.say: [Ghasts](mob:ghast) shoot fireballs. Hit a fireball to send it back, or hide behind [cobblestone](item:cobblestone): it can not break it.

steps.title: Leave them alone
steps.say: [Zombified piglins](mob:zombified_piglin) are calm until you hit one. Then the whole group comes after you.

steps.title: Bring fire resistance
steps.say: A [potion](item:potion) of fire resistance keeps you safe in lava and fire for a few minutes.

steps.title: Find your way back
steps.say: Write down the coordinates of your portal before you explore.

title: Find ancient debris and make netherite

steps.title: Bring a diamond pickaxe
steps.say: Only a [diamond](item:diamond) or [netherite pickaxe](item:netherite_pickaxe) mines [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris). Go to the Nether with food, armor and blocks.

steps.title: Go to level 15
steps.say: [Ancient debris](item:ancient_debris) is deep in the Nether, most of all around level 15. Dig long tunnels there.

steps.title: Spot it
steps.say: [Ancient debris](item:ancient_debris) is brown with swirly lines on the sides. It never touches air, so you have to dig to find it.

steps.title: Smelt it
steps.say: Put [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris) in a [furnace](item:furnace). Each one becomes 1 [netherite scrap](item:netherite_scrap).

steps.title: Make an ingot
steps.say: Craft 4 [netherite scrap](item:netherite_scrap) with 4 [gold ingots](item:gold_ingot) to make 1 netherite ingot.

steps.title: Find an upgrade
steps.say: You also need a [netherite upgrade template](item:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template), found in [chests](item:chest) in [bastions](place:bastion). Copy it with 7 [diamonds](item:diamond) and 1 [netherrack](item:netherrack).

steps.title: Upgrade your gear
steps.say: At a [smithing table](item:smithing_table), put in the template, a [diamond](item:diamond) tool or armor, and the netherite ingot. Netherite things float in lava.

steps.title: Craft a note block
steps.say: Put 1 [redstone dust](item:redstone) in the middle with 8 [planks](item:oak_planks) around it.

steps.title: Play a note
steps.say: Hit the note block to hear its note. Use it to make the note higher, 25 steps in all.

steps.title: Change the sound
steps.say: The block under it changes the sound. Wood plays bass, [stone](item:stone) plays a drum, [sand](item:sand) a snare and [glass](item:glass) a click.

steps.title: More sounds
steps.say: A gold block makes a ringing sound, [wool](item:white_wool) a guitar, [clay](item:clay) a flute and [packed ice](item:packed_ice) chimes. Most other blocks play a piano sound.

steps.title: Play it with redstone
steps.say: A [button](item:oak_button), a [lever](item:lever) or [redstone dust](item:redstone) next to the note block plays it.

steps.title: Make a song
steps.say: Line up note blocks with [redstone repeaters](item:repeater) between them. Each repeater adds a short wait.

title: Make a pumpkin and melon farm

steps.title: Get seeds
steps.say: Craft a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) into 4 [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds), or a [melon slice](item:melon_slice) into 1 [melon](item:melon) seed. Pumpkins grow wild in grassy places, and melons in [jungles](biome:jungle).

steps.title: Make farmland
steps.say: Use a [hoe](item:wooden_hoe) on [dirt](item:dirt) or grass next to water. Seeds grow best with water close by.

steps.title: Leave room
steps.say: Each stem grows its [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon) on an empty block next to it. Leave a strip of plain [dirt](item:dirt) beside every row.

steps.title: Plant and wait
steps.say: Plant the seeds on the [farmland](item:farmland). The stems grow, then a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon) pops out next to them.

steps.title: Harvest the fruit
steps.say: Break only the [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) or [melon](item:melon), not the stem. The stem grows another one.

steps.title: Use them
steps.say: A [melon](item:melon) gives 3 to 7 [melon slices](item:melon_slice) to eat. Use [shears](item:shears) on a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) to carve a face in it.

steps.title: Make an iron door
steps.say: At a [crafting table](item:crafting_table), craft 6 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) into 3 [iron doors](item:iron_door). Iron doors won't open by hand. They need power from something like a [button](item:oak_button).

steps.title: Make a stone button
steps.say: Craft a [stone button](item:stone_button) from 1 [stone](item:stone). To get stone, smelt [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) in a [furnace](item:furnace).

steps.title: Make a pressure plate
steps.say: Craft a [stone pressure plate](item:stone_pressure_plate) from 2 [stone](item:stone). This one goes inside, so you can open the [door](item:oak_door) on your way out.

steps.title: Make a doorway
steps.say: Use a wall of solid blocks like [planks](item:oak_planks) or [stone](item:stone). Make a hole in it 1 block wide and 2 blocks tall, starting at the ground.

steps.title: Place the iron door
steps.say: Stand outside and place the [iron door](item:iron_door) in the hole. Try to open it by hand. It won't open yet, and that's okay.

steps.title: Add the button outside
steps.say: Outside, place the [button](item:oak_button) on the wall block right next to the bottom of the [door](item:oak_door). Use the button, and the door opens, then closes by itself a second later.

steps.title: Add the plate inside
steps.say: Inside, place the [pressure plate](item:oak_pressure_plate) on the floor right in front of the [door](item:oak_door). Step on it to walk out. Keep it inside, because monsters can step on plates too.

steps.title: Try a lever instead
steps.say: Want the [door](item:oak_door) to stay open? Craft a [lever](item:lever) from 1 [stick](item:stick) and 1 [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) and put it beside the door. Flip it to open, flip again to close.

steps.title: Make shears
steps.say: Put 2 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) across from each other, corner to corner, in the crafting grid.

steps.title: Shear a sheep
steps.say: Use the [shears](item:shears) on a sheep. You get 1 to 3 [wool](item:white_wool) and the sheep is not hurt.

steps.title: Let it grow back
steps.say: The sheep eats grass and its [wool](item:white_wool) grows back. Then you can shear it again.

steps.title: Make dye
steps.say: Many flowers make [dye](item:white_dye). A [poppy](item:poppy) makes [red dye](item:red_dye), a [dandelion](item:dandelion) yellow, and a [cornflower](item:cornflower) blue.

steps.title: Dye the sheep
steps.say: Use [dye](item:white_dye) on a sheep and its [wool](item:white_wool) changes color for good. Every shearing gives that color.

steps.title: Or dye the wool
steps.say: Put [wool](item:white_wool) and a [dye](item:white_dye) together in the crafting grid to change its color.

steps.title: Mix colors
steps.say: Breed a red sheep with a white sheep and the lamb can be pink.

steps.title: Gather your wood
steps.say: Find a flat, grassy spot near trees, and start in the daytime. Chop about 30 [logs](item:oak_log) and craft them into [planks](item:oak_planks). Each log makes 4 planks.

steps.title: Lay the floor
steps.say: Place [planks](item:oak_planks) on the ground in a square, 5 blocks long and 5 blocks wide. That's 25 planks.

steps.title: Place the door
steps.say: Craft 6 [planks](item:oak_planks) into 3 [doors](item:oak_door) at a [crafting table](item:crafting_table). Stand outside and place 1 door on the middle block of the front edge of the floor.

steps.title: Build the walls
steps.say: Build walls 3 high on the edge of the floor, up to the [door](item:oak_door). Leave a hole on each side of the door's top half for windows. That's 44 [planks](item:oak_planks).

steps.title: Add the windows
steps.say: Smelt 2 [sand](item:sand) in a [furnace](item:furnace) to make 2 [glass](item:glass). Place 1 glass in each window hole.

steps.title: Put on the roof
steps.say: Cover the top with a flat roof of [planks](item:oak_planks), 5 by 5, using 25 planks. A roof stops [spiders](mob:spider) from climbing in over the walls.

steps.title: Light it up
steps.say: Craft [torches](item:torch) from [coal](item:coal) and [sticks](item:stick). Put 1 on an inside wall, 1 on the roof and a few on the ground outside. Light helps stop monsters from appearing.

steps.title: Place your bed
steps.say: Craft a [bed](item:white_bed) from 3 [wool](item:white_wool) of the same color and 3 [planks](item:oak_planks). Place it by the back wall. Sleep in it at night, and you'll respawn here.

steps.title: Find sugar cane
steps.say: Sugar cane grows next to water, on [beaches](biome:beach) and by [rivers](biome:river) and [swamps](biome:swamp). Break it to collect it.

steps.title: Dig a water line
steps.say: Dig a long, straight ditch 1 block wide and fill it with water from a [bucket](item:bucket).

steps.title: Plant both sides
steps.say: Plant sugar cane on the [dirt](item:dirt), grass or [sand](item:sand) right next to the water, on both sides.

steps.title: Let it grow
steps.say: Sugar cane grows up to 3 blocks tall, even in the dark. [Bone meal](item:bone_meal) makes it grow right away.

steps.title: Harvest it
steps.say: Break the second block up, not the bottom one. The bottom stays and grows again.

steps.title: Use it
steps.say: Craft sugar cane into [sugar](item:sugar), or 3 sugar cane into 3 [paper](item:paper) for maps and [books](item:book).

steps.title: Get raw fish
steps.say: Get a few [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon). Fishing with a [fishing rod](item:fishing_rod) is a great way to catch them. Keep the fish raw, not cooked.

steps.title: Find a stray cat
steps.say: Look for stray cats in [villages](place:village). They like to wander, so check around the houses and nearby.

steps.title: Hold the fish
steps.say: Cats are shy and run from people. Hold the fish, stand still, and let the cat slowly walk up to you.

steps.title: Feed it fish
steps.say: When the cat is close, feed it the fish 1 at a time. It can take a few tries.

steps.title: Look for the collar
steps.say: Smoke means not yet, so keep feeding. Hearts and a red collar mean the cat is yours, and it won't run from you anymore!

steps.title: Make it sit
steps.say: Use your empty hand on your cat to make it sit. Do it again and it gets up and follows you.

steps.title: Heal your cat
steps.say: If your cat gets hurt, feed it [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon) to heal it.

steps.title: See what cats do
steps.say: [Creepers](mob:creeper) stay away from cats, so your cat helps keep you safe. It might sleep on your [bed](item:white_bed) and leave you a [gift](mob:cat#gifts) in the morning.

steps.title: Find a horse
steps.say: Horses live in [plains](biome:plains) and [savannas](biome:savanna). [Donkeys](mob:donkey) live there too, and in [meadows](biome:meadow).

steps.title: Climb on
steps.say: Use the horse with an empty hand to get on. At first it bucks you off.

steps.title: Try again
steps.say: Keep getting back on. Feeding it [apples](item:apple), [sugar](item:sugar) or wheat first helps it calm down faster.

steps.title: Look for hearts
steps.say: When hearts appear, the horse is yours.

steps.title: Get a saddle
steps.say: Craft a [saddle](item:saddle) from 3 [leather](item:leather) and 1 [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot). You can also find them in [chests](item:chest).

steps.title: Saddle up
steps.say: Put the [saddle](item:saddle) on, then get on. Now you can steer, and use jump to leap over [fences](item:oak_fence).

steps.title: Keep it safe
steps.say: Tie your horse to a [fence](item:oak_fence) with a [lead](item:lead) so it does not wander off. [Horse armor](item:leather_horse_armor) protects it.

steps.title: Find a parrot
steps.say: Parrots live in [jungles](biome:jungle). They are red, blue, green, cyan or gray.

steps.title: Bring seeds
steps.say: Any seeds work, like [wheat seeds](item:wheat_seeds), [melon seeds](item:melon_seeds) or [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds). Never use [cookies](item:cookie): they kill parrots.

steps.title: Feed it
steps.say: Feed the parrot seeds until hearts show. It can take a few tries.

steps.title: Shoulder ride
steps.say: Walk into your parrot and it hops on your shoulder. You can carry 2, one on each side.

steps.title: Make it sit
steps.say: Use your parrot to make it sit and stay. Use it again to let it follow you.

steps.title: Dance party
steps.say: Play music on a [jukebox](item:jukebox) near your parrot, and it dances.

steps.title: Get some bones
steps.say: [Skeletons](mob:skeleton) often drop [bones](item:bone) when you defeat them. Collect several, because a wolf can take a few bones to tame.

steps.title: Find a wolf
steps.say: Look for wolves in [forests](biome:forest) and spruce forests, even snowy ones. Never hit a wolf, or its whole pack gets angry and can't be tamed.

steps.title: Feed it bones
steps.say: Hold a [bone](item:bone) near the wolf and it tilts its head at you. Feed it bones 1 at a time.

steps.title: Look for the collar
steps.say: Smoke means not yet, so keep feeding. Hearts and a red collar mean your wolf is tamed!

steps.title: Make it sit
steps.say: Use your empty hand on your wolf to make it sit and stay. Do it again and it stands up and follows you.

steps.title: Take it along
steps.say: A standing wolf follows you around. If you get too far away, it can teleport to catch up with you.

steps.title: Heal your wolf
steps.say: If its tail hangs low, your wolf is hurt. Feed it meat like [steak](item:cooked_beef) or [cooked chicken](item:cooked_chicken) to heal it. Even [rotten flesh](item:rotten_flesh) works.

steps.title: Color its collar
steps.say: Want a new look? Use any [dye](item:white_dye) on your wolf to change its collar color.

title: Tool upgrades: wood, stone, iron, diamond

steps.title: Wood first
steps.say: A [wooden pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) is made from [planks](item:oak_planks) and [sticks](item:stick). It mines [stone](item:stone) and [coal ore](item:coal_ore), and breaks fast.

steps.title: Then stone
steps.say: Use [cobblestone](item:cobblestone) instead of [planks](item:oak_planks) for a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe). It mines [iron ore](item:iron_ore), [copper ore](item:copper_ore) and [lapis lazuli ore](item:lapis_ore).

steps.title: Then iron
steps.say: Smelt [raw iron](item:raw_iron) in a [furnace](item:furnace) to get [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot). An [iron pickaxe](item:iron_pickaxe) mines [diamond ore](item:diamond_ore), [gold ore](item:gold_ore), [redstone ore](item:redstone_ore) and [emerald ore](item:emerald_ore).

steps.title: Then diamond
steps.say: A [diamond pickaxe](item:diamond_pickaxe) takes 3 [diamonds](item:diamond) and 2 [sticks](item:stick). It is the only kind that mines [obsidian](item:obsidian) and [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris), besides netherite.

steps.title: Netherite is best
steps.say: At a [smithing table](item:smithing_table), add a [netherite ingot](item:netherite_ingot) and a [netherite upgrade template](item:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template) to a [diamond](item:diamond) tool. It turns into netherite.

steps.title: Fix your tools
steps.say: Put 2 worn tools of the same kind together in the crafting grid to make one fixed tool. An [anvil](item:anvil) fixes them and keeps their enchantments.

steps.title: Find a villager with a job
steps.say: Villagers with jobs wear aprons, hats or other work clothes. Ones in plain robes have no job yet.

steps.title: See their trades
steps.say: Use a villager to see what they want and what they give.

steps.title: Get emeralds
steps.say: [Emeralds](item:emerald) are like money. Sell things villagers want, like wheat, [paper](item:paper) or [coal](item:coal), to get them.

steps.title: Buy things
steps.say: Spend your [emeralds](item:emerald) on tools, food, maps, [enchanted books](item:enchanted_book) and more.

steps.title: Unlock more trades
steps.say: The more you trade with a villager, the more they level up and the more trades they offer.

steps.title: Give them a job
steps.say: Place a job block near a villager with no job. A [lectern](item:lectern) makes a librarian, and a [composter](item:composter) makes a farmer.

steps.title: Keep them safe
steps.say: [Zombies](mob:zombie) attack villagers at night. Light up the village and build walls.

title: Use an anvil to fix and name things

steps.title: Craft an anvil
steps.say: You need 3 [blocks of iron](item:iron_block) on top and 4 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot) below. That is 31 iron ingots in all.

steps.title: Fix a tool
steps.say: Put the tool in the first slot and what it is made of in the second, like [diamonds](item:diamond) for a [diamond sword](item:diamond_sword).

steps.title: Join 2 tools
steps.say: Or put 2 of the same tool in. You get one fixed tool, with the enchantments of both.

steps.title: Add an enchanted book
steps.say: Put a tool in the first slot and an [enchanted book](item:enchanted_book) in the second to add its enchantment.

steps.title: Give it a name
steps.say: Type a new name at the top before you take it out. Name a [name tag](item:name_tag) this way, then use it on a pet.

steps.title: It costs XP
steps.say: Each use costs experience levels. If it says too expensive, the cost is over 39 levels.

steps.title: It wears out
steps.say: Every use can crack the anvil a little. After a while it breaks, so keep iron for a new one.

steps.title: Make a hoe
steps.say: Make a [wooden hoe](item:wooden_hoe) at a [crafting table](item:crafting_table) with 2 [planks](item:oak_planks) and 2 [sticks](item:stick). A [stone](item:stone) or [iron hoe](item:iron_hoe) works too.

steps.title: Collect wheat seeds
steps.say: Break grass to find [wheat seeds](item:wheat_seeds). Only some grass drops a seed, so keep going until you have a handful.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.say: Pick a flat grassy spot and dig 1 hole in the middle. Fill a [bucket](item:bucket) at a lake or [river](biome:river) and pour the water in.

steps.title: Hoe the ground
steps.say: Use your [hoe](item:wooden_hoe) on the ground all around the water to make [farmland](item:farmland). Water keeps farmland wet up to 4 blocks away in every direction.

steps.title: Plant the seeds
steps.say: Place 1 seed on each [farmland](item:farmland) block. Walk on your farm but never jump, because jumping on farmland turns it back into [dirt](item:dirt).

steps.title: Protect your farm
steps.say: Build a [fence](item:oak_fence) with a gate around your farm to keep mobs from trampling it. Put [torches](item:torch) on the fence posts so monsters don't spawn nearby.

steps.title: Speed it up
steps.say: Wheat takes time to grow. Use [bone meal](item:bone_meal) on a wheat plant to help it grow faster. You can make bone meal from a [bone](item:bone).

steps.title: Harvest and replant
steps.say: When the wheat turns brown, break it to get wheat and usually some seeds. Plant seeds back in each spot. 3 wheat make 1 [bread](item:bread)!

title: What to do when you die

steps.title: Your things drop
steps.say: When you die, everything you carry falls on the ground where you died. You also drop some of your experience.

steps.title: Know where you were
steps.say: Turn on Show Coordinates in the world settings. Then you can see where you are, and write down where you died.

steps.title: Go back fast
steps.say: Your things vanish after 5 minutes on the ground near you. Run back the same way you came.

steps.title: Stay safe on the way
steps.say: Whatever got you is probably still there. Bring a [sword](item:wooden_sword), some food and a few blocks.

steps.title: Make a recovery compass
steps.say: Put 8 [echo shards](item:echo_shard) around a [compass](item:compass). It points to where you last died. Echo shards are in [chests](item:chest) in [ancient cities](place:ancient_city).

steps.title: Things lost for good
steps.say: Things that fall into lava, or into the empty space under the End, are gone. Next time, keep away from edges.

steps.title: Keep your things
steps.say: A grown-up can turn on Keep Inventory in the world settings, under Cheats. Then you keep everything when you die.
